description:
## Problem
Constraint-bearing `CREATE TABLE` statements are always `unverifiable` (`introspection.py:492-496`), so constraint-enabled runs, including every shipped DuckDB template, can never verify.

## Change (per gate D-2)
- Add constraint kinds to `introspection.py`. `_classify` extracts `PRIMARY KEY (…)`, `UNIQUE (…)` and `FOREIGN KEY (…) REFERENCES t(…)` after literal stripping.
- Extend `_Intent` and `IntrospectedObject` with `referenced_table` and `referenced_columns`. For FKs, `_match_object` requires equal child columns, referenced table and referenced columns.
- The DuckDB introspector adds `duckdb_constraints()` facts, bounded and filtered.
- Platforms without a rule stay `unverifiable`.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Fail-closed: anything unparsed or without a source blocks.
- No widening for existing kinds.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
- This item touches paths listed in the soundness manifest by `tuning-trust-paths-soundness-manifest-20261001`. The PR needs an external `Soundness review:` section (AGENTS.md) and must not auto-merge.
